title: On-Demand Image Processing & CDN Delivery
learningObjectives: Implement on-demand image resizing, cropping, and WebP/AVIF format conversion
Cache transformed variants on global CDN edge nodes
Protect dynamic transform endpoints with HMAC signature validation (anti-DDoS)
keyTradeoffs: Pre-generating all size variants at upload time vs on-demand edge generation
Self-hosted Sharp/Libvips service vs cloud provider image services (Cloudinary)
commonPitfalls: Unsigned transform URLs allowing attackers to exhaust CPU and storage with arbitrary size permutations
Missing cache-control headers on immutable processed image assets
transferPrompt: How does high-throughput binary image streaming differ from streaming large CSV text exports?
